messages:
Ava: Morning async — quick standup. What I did: rolled back the kv-evict canary after seeing 3% tail-latency regressions, added extra debug logs to the batcher, and opened an RCA draft. Blockers: still seeing intermittent 504s when queue depth spikes; flamegraphs unclear. Today: tune backpressure + open PR for autoscaler cooldown tweak. @Ravi can you sanity-check the heap profile I uploaded? :coffee:

Ravi: I pulled the logs. There's a GC pause cluster around 03:21 UTC that correlates with the 504s. Quick command to repro fetch: `kubectl logs -n inference -l app=batcher --since=10m | grep -E "GC|504"` — looks like several long STW events. I'll try a heapdump this afternoon and share.

Marta: Thanks @Ava. Re: canary rollback — I re-ran the golden tests and traffic split is back to 100% stable. I'll follow up with the canary notes in the PR so we don't miss the config change. Also opened ticket INF-482 for alert threshold docs.

Jin: tiny follow-up — noticed the alert for batcher-queue-length fired 4x overnight. I muted the noisy rule for now and added a Jira comment. Suggest we move to a rate-based alert instead of absolute count.

Ava: @Jin good call. I'll prototype a rate-based rule this morning. For context, current rule: `sum(rate(batcher_queue_length[5m])) > 1000` — thinking `increase(...)` or percentiles might be better.

Ravi: FYI the GC looks like old hotspots in our Python runtime; bumping the worker JVM heap didn't help. Could be a straggler model process holding memory. I'll trace model forks.

ops-bot: Incident #INF-2026 closed (504 storm) — responders: Ava, Ravi — duration 38m — summary available: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INF-2026 :white_check_mark:

Marta: Blocker for me — need owners to review the canary rollback PR before EOD, otherwise I'll roll forward tomorrow. @Ava can you add review notes?

Ava: Will do. Also pinged @Ravi for perf annotations on the PR.

Jin: Quick ask — can we add an automation to annotate alerts with last-deploy commit SHA? It would have helped during the rollback. I can draft a small lambda.

Ava: +1 to the annotation idea. If you share a short proposal I'll attach it to the postmortem.

Ravi: Plan for today: capture heapdump, run a short memstress on the batcher image, and start a tiny canary with increased padding.

Marta: Plan: merge rollback notes, file follow-up SRE ticket for rate alerts, and coordinate with infra for deploy window tomorrow.

Ava: Thanks team. No major blockers beyond GC tracing. If nothing else, I'll post updates in this thread. :camera_flash:
